items.why: Volatility spikes as the Dow and S&P 500 enter correction and the Nasdaq erases its 2026 gain.
Nvidia slides after a report of an SEC accounting probe and CEO transition fallout, deepening the post-earnings slide.
AMD sinks with the AI trade melting down as the Nasdaq erases its 2026 gains.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures are down 5.3% and S&P futures down 3.46% as the AI sell-off continues.
summary: Stocks are selling off hard, with the Dow and S&P 500 entering correction and the Nasdaq erasing its 2026 gain as the AI trade melts down. Chip names lead the slide and volatility is spiking.
